definitions.gloss: alopecia; hair loss disease; hair loss condition
definitions.explanation: a medical condition in which hair falls out from the scalp or other parts of the body

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}になった。
{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。

{円形脱毛症|えんけいだつもうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{発症|はっしょう}する→発症する：22367_hasshousuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧な⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Alopecia areata can develop suddenly, and the psychological burden is significant.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧ (hair loss; hair removal) + {症|しょう} (disease; condition). The most commonly discussed type is {円形脱毛症|えんけいだつもうしょう} (alopecia areata), which causes round patches of hair loss and is often linked to stress or autoimmune factors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱毛症|だつもうしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to develop alopecia
- {脱毛症|だつもうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: treatment for alopecia
- ⟦{円形|えんけい}→円形：11674_enkei⟧{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}: alopecia areata (circular hair loss)
- {男性型|だんせいがた}{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}: male pattern baldness (androgenetic alopecia)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧: hair loss; hair removal — the base word; can also mean deliberate hair removal (waxing, laser)
- ⟦{薄毛|うすげ}→薄毛：20459_usuge⟧: thinning hair — a less clinical, everyday term
- ⟦{禿|はげ}→禿：24436_hage⟧: baldness — colloquial and potentially rude when used about a person
